summary: The working-tree lock no longer matches BLVM-2026-0101 through BLVM-2026-0117
details: Correction of BLVM-2026-0101 through BLVM-2026-0117. Those files stay as published. Their details name iroh 0.95, hickory-proto 0.25.2, quinn-proto before 0.11.18, and wasmtime 36.0.19. The blvm lock on 2026-11-15 has iroh 1.0.0, hickory-proto 0.26.3, hickory-resolver 0.26.3, quinn 0.11.12, quinn-proto 0.11.19, and wasmtime 36.0.20. The blvm-node lock has the same iroh, hickory, and quinn-proto versions and no wasmtime package. cargo audit on both locks reported no vulnerabilities. BLVM-2026-0101 through BLVM-2026-0117 stay open: this lock has no commit and no release tag. Reporter credit is pending consent.
